description: The size of the Ohey feed and the last seven full UTC days of changes to it, ending the day before asOf. hosts: hosts in the feed now. denied: hosts confirmed as legitimate services and kept out. week.added (and daily): hosts that entered the feed. week.entered: website tips that reached review. week.accepted: of those, the ones accepted into the feed. week.removed: tips an analyst rejected at review. added counts every host that entered the feed that week, whenever and however it was submitted, so it can exceed accepted. archive counts are all-time totals. entered need not equal accepted plus removed: the rest were denied, are still in review, or were decided after the week. week.denied: hosts confirmed legitimate that week. week.delisted: hosts that had been in the feed and moved to the delisted feed that week. archive: the scanner's captures, the responses in them, host IP observations, response bodies judged malicious or clean, and feed status changes.
name: get_feed_stats
title: Get feed statistics
